title: Who We Are
text: We connect home cooks with customers who appreciate fresh, homemade food. Our platform allows talented home chefs to earn while sharing their love for cooking.

section.title: Our Vision
section.content: To create a world where homemade meals are accessible to everyone while empowering home-makers with financial independence.

section.title: Why Choose Us
section.text:
Experience the warmth of homemade food crafted by passionate home chefs. 

Our meals are fresh, nutritious, and prepared with care—bringing authentic flavors straight to your table. 

By choosing us, you not only enjoy healthier meals but also support local home-makers, empowering them to share their culinary skills with the world.
